milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The mossy stone brick structure is centered at spawn-relative (5, 2, 6) — the front wall at z=4 with the building extending to z=10. The player must be within 5 blocks and facing toward the structure (60° tolerance) to demonstrate they have visually located it. This rule type was chosen over position_inside_box because the task is about observing/finding the block type, not just being near it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The ladder is on the interior right wall at spawn-relative (7, 1, 8). Max distance of 4 blocks ensures the player has entered the building (entrance is at z=4, ladder at z=8, so player must walk inside to be within 4 blocks). Facing tolerance of 60° ensures the player is looking at the ladder. This correctly models 'player can see the ladder' after entering the structure.

Uses inventory_has because mining a trapped chest causes it to drop as an item which the player picks up. The trapped chest is at spawn-relative (5, 6, 7) on the upper floor accessed via the ladder. It is not in the player's starting inventory (player only starts with iron_pickaxe), so having trapped_chest in inventory with min_count=1 confirms it was successfully mined.
